title: ScoreResponse
description: Response body of GET /score/{profile} and POST /score/custom. Frozen contract between the scoring library (Person 1) and the API/frontend (Person 2).

profile.description: Profile id that was scored, e.g. "house".

resolution.description: H3 resolution of every cell id in `cells`.

generated_at.description: UTC timestamp (ISO 8601) at which the response was generated.

cells.description: One entry per scored H3 cell.

h3.description: H3 cell index as a 15-character lowercase hex string.

score.description: Final score in [0, 1] (sustainability × feasibility), or null when the cell is masked.

masked.description: True when a hard no-go mask of the profile applies to this cell.

breakdown.description: Signed contribution of each layer relative to the regional mean: weight × (normalised_value − regional_mean), direction-corrected so positive always means 'helps the score'.
